༄༅/ /bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sman sgrub gyi sngags byang zur du bkol ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sman sgrub gyi sngags byang zur du bkol ba bzhugs so//

bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sman sgrub kyi sngags byang zur du bkol ba ni/ khrol bu sbyong tshul gsum gyi dang po/ dam pa rigs brgyas sbyang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ra sa yā na ta na dza ya gu h+ya sid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ stong dang*/ slar ci mang bzla'o// gnyis pa de nyid rigs lnga'i bsnyen pas sbyangs shing bzhu btul bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dz+nyā na ra tsa s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces brgya rtsa bzla/ bai ro tsa na/ oṃ muṃ dhā twī shwa ri/ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ laṃ dwe ṣa ra ti/ rat+na saṃ bha wa trāṃ/ maṃ mo ha ra ti/ aṃ ā ro lika/ paṃ rā ga ra ti/ a mo gha sid+dhi hoḥ taṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes stong sogs bzla| gsum pa gsang chen rigs gcig gis sbyang ba ni/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes stong sogs bzla'o// phyi ma sgrub pa dgu'i 'dzab ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes ci mang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i 'dzab ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ bdud rtsi dbab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta pra we sha ya pra we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes pa stong*/ ma mo bcu drug gi bsnyen pa ni/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes ci mang bzla/ dngos grub dbang du bya ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes pa stong*/ lha gnad la dbab ste dngos grub blang ba ni/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta mañju shrī bya lo ki te hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes stong*/ dngos grub len khar srid pa dbang du gsol ba ni/ oṃ āḥhoḥsu khaṃ dharma kā ya a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes stong bzla'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
